facts.text: The user requested a comprehensive 2 weeks content plan with 3 topics per day.
The user asked for the content plan to be written assuming the assistant is an Australian construction lawyer and an expert in SEO and content.
The user provided a list of topic ideas related to fair trading cost plus contracts and requested that all of them be included in the plan.
The user asked the assistant to reply with the word "acknowledged" if the instructions were understood.
